caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a framed mirror or picture, with ornate decorative elements surrounding it. The central rectangular section appears to be a reflective or smooth surface, bordered by a patterned frame that contains repeating starburst or floral motifs. On either side of the frame, there are symmetrical, curved forms that extend outward, each decorated with stitched or etched lines and matching star patterns. The top of the frame is adorned with a scalloped crest that features a circular, floral motif in the center. A thin ribbon or loop, colored light brown or gold, is attached to the top center of the object, suggesting it can be hung. The predominant colors in the drawing are shades of gray and off-white, used to depict the frame, with the ribbon providing the only contrasting color. The composition is symmetric, emphasizing decorative detail and structure.
title: Tin Mirror Frame
